overlap_projection_contract.interpretation: Every model-visible, optimization-visible, and protected textual field needs a source/revision/role-specific reviewed inventory. Generated attestations are software tests only.

reference_contract.interpretation: The map fixes one target and two protected operational capability slices per setting. Closed-world hash-sorted semantic-cluster apportionment prevents outcome-dependent split movement but does not establish construct validity or semantic independence.

blocking_gaps: the multi-field overlap schema is executable for small exhaustive fixtures, but all source-specific inventories are null and the external engine still indexes record pairs rather than field segments

optimizer_window.packing_isolation: variable-length attention boundaries plus reset position identifiers
optimizer_window.comparison_rule: Every method uses the same eight-pack capacity, response-token interval, world size, candidate stream, and optimizer-step schedule. A plan outside the interval is infeasible.

data_roles.split_rule: Use experiments/sft_reference_contract.json: derive each complete reviewed semantic-cluster UID from the semantic-audit hash and sorted member record IDs, derive a source/revision/cluster assignment digest, sort by that digest within source, and apportion cluster counts 80/5/10/5 by Hamilton largest remainder with the frozen partition tie order. Empty required partitions block rather than moving a boundary. Sealed benchmarks never enter this split.
data_roles.clipping_timing: Compute response-token-average NLL per example, then clip for gate use only.

actual_update_gate.sampling: with replacement from the frozen gate distribution
actual_update_gate.scale_evaluation: one fresh block per protected slice and round, reused as a paired block across every scale in the frozen grid

cost_design.meter: sum over accelerators of scheduler allocation interval in seconds; device events are utilization diagnostics only
cost_design.overrun_rule: Retain and mark the run as a protocol failure. Before opening audits, refreeze a larger reserve and restart every paired method from the common initial state.

primary_factorial.evidence_status: Exploratory H1 mechanism pilot only. H2, H3, confirmatory thresholds, and the 50M-token study are not frozen.
primary_factorial.frozen_hypothesis: H1-mechanism: measured profiled cost and fixed-budget pack search interact beyond their two main effects on the target/protected frontier.

cells.additive_token__deterministic_best_fit: select with additive response-token cost, then deterministic length-descending best fit
cells.additive_token__fixed_budget_beam: fixed-budget beam uses additive response-token cost during every expansion
cells.measured_nonlinear__deterministic_best_f: map each proposed subset to its deterministic best-fit packing and test budget feasibility using the calibrated cost of that exact packing
cells.measured_nonlinear__fixed_budget_beam: fixed-budget beam jointly tracks calibrated execution cost and physical pack state for every partial plan

primary_factorial.contrast_formula: (HV_measured,beam - HV_measured,best-fit) - (HV_additive,beam - HV_additive,best-fit), computed within seed, target setting, and budget before averaging
primary_factorial.budget_feasibility: Every cell reserves and charges the realized cost of its own packing. The best-fit cells evaluate their unique deterministic packing; beam cells evaluate each retained physical plan. No cell uses C*(B) from a packing it does not execute.
primary_factorial.pairing_unit: common initial checkpoint, seed, target setting, budget fraction, candidate stream, and protected-tolerance grid

hypervolume_coordinates.x: target audit NLL minus initial target audit NLL; lower is better
hypervolume_coordinates.y: maximum protected audit NLL minus its corresponding initial audit NLL; lower is better
hypervolume_coordinates.outside_box_rule: clip each coordinate only for hypervolume integration at its reference coordinate; retain and report the unclipped endpoint
hypervolume_coordinates.dominated_or_duplicate_rule: remove dominated points and count duplicate coordinates once within each frozen tolerance frontier

primary_factorial.paired_interval: paired max-t bootstrap that resamples the five seed blocks jointly across every target-by-budget contrast; reported as exploratory because five seeds do not support reliable tail calibration
primary_factorial.multiplicity: max-statistic across budgets and target settings
primary_factorial.missing_run_rule: retain failure and assign the worst endpoint in the frozen reference box; also report complete cases
primary_factorial.infeasible_plan_rule: record the null action with its charged search cost; never repair a cell using another cell's packing algorithm

prompt_frame.selection_rule: first 2048 examples after sorting SHA-256(source revision || stable problem id)
prompt_frame.hidden_evaluator_status: No hidden evaluator is admitted by this mathematics-only H1 pre-pilot. Any later code or held-out evaluator must be registered, cleared, materialized as a sealed role, and deduplicated before execution.
prompt_frame.claim_scope: Estimator selection targets D_select; the untouched report targets the separately normalized D_confirm. Neither is labeled an estimate for the full 2048-prompt law.

decoder.eos_rule: EOS is scored as sampled; reaching the maximum records a truncation outcome
decoder.allowed_vocabulary: deterministic tokenizer vocabulary minus only permanently invalid token ids

estimator_audit.projection_distribution: independent Rademacher entries scaled by 1/sqrt(64), generated in row-major order
estimator_audit.parameter_order: lexicographic fully qualified names of trainable LoRA tensors, each flattened in contiguous row-major order
estimator_audit.response_token_cost: C includes every sampled response token through and including EOS; a no-EOS response includes every token through the fixed truncation limit
estimator_audit.reference_independence: For each of D_select and D_confirm, R1 and R2 are mutually independent and independent of every candidate replication.
estimator_audit.reference_storage: retain every per-trajectory projected gradient and trajectory id separately for R1 and R2
estimator_audit.projected_mse_estimator: (g_hat - R1)^T (g_hat - R2), averaged over paired replications; individual values may be negative
estimator_audit.mse_interval: three-way nonparametric bootstrap: jointly resample paired candidate replication IDs across cells and independently resample R1 and R2 trajectories; recompute raw MSE, measured cost, nonnegative MSE-cost risk, and selected-minus-control contrasts; 2000 replicates with seed 2026090392, exact multinomial sufficient statistics, and nearest-rank 0.025/0.975 quantiles
estimator_audit.candidate_replication_pairing: Within each target law, replication_id denotes a common predeclared seed block across every candidate cell. One multinomial replication-weight vector is shared across cells in each bootstrap draw; selection and confirmation laws use separate streams.
estimator_audit.bootstrap_resource_bound: At most 32 bootstrap draws are resident per source/cell. With 64 projected coordinates, 2048 rows per reference sample, 250 candidate replications per cell, and 2000 bootstrap draws, the vectorized sufficient-statistic implementation avoids materializing resampled trajectory tensors.
estimator_audit.selection_rule: At fixed 64-trajectory and verifier-call counts, minimize max(raw cross-reference projected MSE, 0) times mean complete-replication allocated accelerator-seconds. The unclipped raw MSE is always retained. Ties choose lower measured cost, then larger alpha, then lexicographic allocation_id.
estimator_audit.confirmation_required_cells: Evaluate the selected cell and the alpha=1 on-policy control on untouched D_confirm replications; if alpha=1 is selected these are one cell.
estimator_audit.confirmation_primary_contrast: selected minus alpha=1 difference in raw projected MSE and nonnegative MSE-cost selection risk under D_confirm, each with a jointly paired three-way bootstrap interval; estimator-claim eligibility is reported separately from this contrast
estimator_audit.allocation_restriction: For this exploratory grid only, alpha equals n_current/(n_current+n_stale). This is not required for unbiasedness; confirmation must cross mixture mass with source allocation.

artifact_contract.cost_unit: allocated accelerator-seconds recorded on every attempted trajectory; candidate-cell cost is the mean complete replication sum and reference cost is retained separately
artifact_contract.failure_rule: Any infrastructure failure blocks estimator-claim eligibility and confirmatory comparison; no success-conditioned MSE or selected alpha is reported.
artifact_contract.summary_binding: evaluate/summary.json records the exact train/trajectory_ledger.jsonl SHA-256; point MSE, nonnegative selection risk, cell cost, selection argmin, selected and alpha=1 untouched confirmation cells, and their contrast are recomputed from that ledger.
artifact_contract.three_way_bootstrap: Jointly resample complete paired candidate replication IDs across cells and independently resample R1 trajectories and R2 trajectories within each target law; use chunked exact multinomial weights and projected sufficient statistics to recompute MSE, cost, risk, and selected-minus-control percentile intervals rather than accepting reported bounds.
artifact_contract.bootstrap_seed_schedule: For each target law, initialize NumPy 2.5.3 PCG64 from the first 64 bits of SHA-256('rl-three-way-bootstrap-v1' | base seed | target law); use nearest-rank 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles.
artifact_contract.fixture_status: The generated self-test uses hand-computed two-dimensional vectors, reports empirical_evidence=false, and cannot populate paper result cells.

frame.root_selection_rule: retain all 200 reasoning roots, take the first 200 math roots after sorting SHA-256(dataset revision || question_id), and retain all 128 coding roots
frame.target_root_mass: one third per source and uniform within source, so each root has mass 1/(3*n_source)
frame.frame_interpretation: weighted public LiveBench frame only; not a product-domain or deployment-population sample

acquisition.evi_candidate_law: Draw 256 IID target units with replacement from pi at each adaptive batch start before computing EVI.
acquisition.evi_candidate_multiplicity_rule: For multiplicity n_C(x), r_C(x)=n_C(x)*exp(g(x))/sum_u n_C(u)*exp(g(u)); units absent from the multiset receive r_C(x)=0.
acquisition.evi_candidate_seed_rule: SHA-256 domain-separated stream keyed by preregistration hash, batch index, and base seed 2026090322
acquisition.evi_logsumexp: subtract the maximum finite g over the candidate multiset before exponentiation; duplicate units are represented by log multiplicity

evi_resource_ceiling.failure_rule: If the ceiling is exceeded or a registered batch cannot finish, retain the failure and do not collect that batch's human outcomes.

acquisition.fixed_slot_rule: All 1000 assignment slots remain in the ledger. Unavailability, withdrawal, quota binding, or nonresponse records R_t=0 in the original slot; no replacement occurs and later slots continue.

working_posterior.jury_prompt_revision_rule: SHA-256 of the rendered rubric and system prompt
working_posterior.posterior_representation: q_b(theta) is the frozen Gaussian Laplace approximation N(theta_hat_b, H_b^-1)
working_posterior.state_probability: common-random-number Monte Carlo probability that Delta(theta) lies above delta, below -delta, or inside [-delta,delta]
working_posterior.posterior_predictive: common-random-number Monte Carlo integral of the Davidson categorical likelihood under q_b
working_posterior.hypothetical_update: At theta_hat_b compute g=grad log p_theta(y|x) and J=-Hessian log p_theta(y|x). Set H_new=H_b+J+hessian_damping*I and theta_new=theta_hat_b+solve(H_new+newton_ridge*I,g); covariance is inverse(H_new+newton_ridge*I).
working_posterior.factorization: symmetric Cholesky after adding jitter in the fixed sequence [0, 1e-10, 1e-9, 1e-8, 1e-7, 1e-6]
working_posterior.factorization_failure: Set EVI_b(x)=0 for the affected x, retain and report the failure, and do not retry with an unregistered update.
working_posterior.acquisition_scope: approximate Bayesian risk-reduction score; alignment with the terminal confidence-set action is tested, not assumed

human_protocol.same_root_repeated_for_one_rater: not prohibited; repeats are retained because resampling would change the logged draw law
human_protocol.pilot_connectivity: No requirement that every human rater appear in the 200-attempt pilot; human-rater effects use a proper partial-pooling prior. Connectivity checks apply only to the model-judge design.
human_protocol.audit_nonresponse: Use all 200 fixed audit slots. Substitute -1/+1 endpoint outcomes for missing ratings and add one-sided Hoeffding radius sqrt(2*log(2/alpha)/200); never drop or replace a slot.
adaptive_audit_required_fields: joint covariance estimator accounting for shared raters

nonresponse.primary: worst-case martingale-Hoeffding interval whenever any outcome is missing
nonresponse.secondary: prequential inverse-response weighted analysis under stated MAR and response positivity

simulation.required_before_execution: The fractional screening layout is frozen, but executable DGP equations, missingness laws, resource/restart plan, and faithful Active Testing/CVE/PPAT/Neyman/EVI implementations must be hashed in a replacement preregistration.

screening_design.interpretation: The 16-row fraction is crossed with decision-boundary effects and three working-model regimes, with center-point local alternatives. It replaces the infeasible full Cartesian crossing; aliased two-factor interactions require targeted follow-up.
